about: The shape an Arrow stream's schema says, read before any row (ADR-0341): each column's name and kind by ADR-0065's table. Transcribed from ExGrid.Data.Arrow.Tests' ShapeTests.

cases.name: ADR-0341: a stream's shape is its schema's, by ADR-0065's table
ADR-0341: a shape is read from the schema alone, so a value the rows would be refused for does not stop it
ADR-0341: a shape is read from the schema alone, so a stream cut after it still says its shape
ADR-0341: dates, timestamps and times give Date
ADR-0341: an Arrow file says its schema after its rows, so its shape is not read from it

refused.message: An Arrow file says its schema in its footer, after its rows; a shape is read from an Arrow stream, whose schema comes first.

cases.name: ADR-0341: bytes that are not an Arrow stream say no shape

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0341: a schema with a type outside ADR-0065's table says no shape, naming the column and the type

refused.message: Column 'Value': the Arrow type struct<a: int64> is not one a Snapshot reads.

cases.name: ADR-0341: a schema with a name twice says no shape

refused.message: Column 'A': the Arrow stream has two columns of this name, and a column's name is unique within a Snapshot.
